esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; MQ-5 LPG / natural gas sensor module needs at least 4.9 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.DO → D25 (GPIO25). U2.AO → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added the mq5.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the AO voltage and the DO alarm set on the controls: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; MQ-5 LPG / natural gas sensor module needs at least 4.9 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.DO → GP2 (GPIO2). U2.AO → GP28 (GPIO28) — an analog-capable pin. Added the mq5.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the AO voltage and the DO alarm set on the controls: passes
